create_atom_images: create AtomImages from a list of ase.Atoms with custom element radii and radii scale
create_atom_gui: create an AtomGui instance with a ViewConfig, atom images, and custom element colors
draw_elements: draw atoms, bonds, cell lines, and miller planes on a tkinter canvas from element groups
draw_circle: draw a colored circle on a tkinter canvas with optional selection outline and stroke width
draw_axes: draw XYZ axes with colored labels on a tkinter canvas at a given window size
